Annual Spring Camp 2026

3 Days in Qadisha & Cedars Valleys

Our signature annual spring wilderness camp. Tenting under the stars, patrol woodcraft, campfire lore, and high-altitude mountain hiking.

Qadisha Valley & Bcharre High Meadows

Parish Feast May 5, 2026 Full Day • All Units (4 – 24) & Families

Saint Jean Marc Feast Day & 49th Anniversary

Parish Celebration & Official Group Parade

Celebrating our 49th anniversary since May 5, 1977. Official troop parade through ancient Byblos, solemn mass, and Scout Promise investitures.

10-Day Grand Camp July 18 – 28, 2026 10 Days • Ages 4 – 24 (All Branches)

Grand Summer Camp 2026 (Grand Camp)

10 Days of Autonomous Wilderness Living

The crown jewel of the scout year. Building 100% wooden camp infrastructure (froissartage kitchens, dining tables), night bivouacs, and exploration treks.

Mount Lebanon High Plateau

Civic Service May 16, 2026 Half Day • All Units (4 – 24)

Old Byblos Coastline Clean-Up

Scout Civic & Environmental Service

All units join together to clean and preserve the historic Byblos shoreline, sorting recyclables in partnership with local environmental groups.

Scout Des Cèdres كشافة الأرز
Groupe Saint Jean Marc فوج القديس يوحنا مرقس

Founded on May 5, 1977. Serving youth through fellowship, outdoor woodcraft, personal character, and civic service at Saint Jean Marc, Byblos. تأسس الفوج في ٥ أيار ١٩٧٧. تنشئة أجيال على روح الأخوة، مهارات الخلاء، بناء الشخصية، وخدمة المجتمع في رعية مار يوحنا مرقس، جبيل.
